async def act(page):
    # Fill in the project name for the new repository
    # Try to locate the project name input using accessibility roles
    project_name_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    if await project_name_input.count() == 0:
        # Fallback to label if role not found
        project_name_input = page.get_by_label('Project name')
    # Fill with the specified repository name
    await project_name_input.fill('awesome_llm_reading?')
    # Wait briefly for UI updates
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Find and click the button to create the project
    create_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project')
    if await create_button.count() == 0:
        create_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Create blank project')
    if await create_button.count() == 0:
        create_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Create')
    # Click to create the repository
    await create_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after creation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
